description: Feature flag engine test vectors. Every implementation (sdk/flags-core, the TypeScript SDK, the server and the Python SDK) must pass all of them. Rollout weights are out of 100000; buckets run 0..99999 = murmur3_x86_32(utf8(flagKey + "." + salt + "." + text(bucketBy attribute)), seed 0) mod 100000. Segment vectors: an evaluation case may carry `segments` (the environment's segments, passed to evaluate); segmentValidation cases are checked with validateSegment.
